findings.governingReading: Rin stops compounding the medicine she is preparing for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English turns hands-on preparation of a specific medicine into filling prescriptions.

findings.governingReading: Rin rises roughly and abruptly in anger.
findings.explanation: The English omits the force of her movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分がどれだけ弱ってるか
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no idea how physically weakened he has become.
findings.explanation: The English reduces bodily debilitation to exhaustion.

findings.governingReading: Rin descends the stairs while hurrying toward the entrance.
findings.explanation: The English adds a dash to the stair descent.

findings.highlight: She has to check on Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜に言いつけておかないといけない
findings.governingReading: Before pursuing Shirou, Rin must leave Sakura instructions.
findings.explanation: The English changes an intended communication into a welfare check.

findings.highlight: She hasn’t taken her temperature either
findings.evidenceJa: 今朝は熱も計っていない
findings.governingReading: Rin has not yet taken Sakura’s temperature this morning.
findings.explanation: The English removes the morning time boundary.

findings.evidenceJa: 時間にしてほんの一分だ
findings.governingReading: Rin estimates that checking Sakura and leaving instructions will take only one minute.
findings.explanation: The English turns a prospective duration into time already elapsed.

findings.highlight: stop, and rest at the bottom of the hill
findings.evidenceJa: 下り坂の途中でぜいぜいと立ち止まる
findings.governingReading: Rin predicts Shirou will stop wheezing partway down the slope.
findings.explanation: The English moves him to the bottom and adds resting.

findings.highlight: The worst part is that he doesn’t realize it
findings.evidenceJa: 本人が気付いてないあたりが厄介
findings.governingReading: What makes Shirou troublesome to manage is that he himself does not notice his condition.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies this into the worst aspect without support.

findings.highlight: It’s natural that the strongest one looks after the weaker members
findings.evidenceJa: 余力がある分、ダウンしている[ruby text=メンバー char=2]仲間の面倒を見るのは当然の義務
findings.governingReading: Because Rin has strength to spare, caring for her downed comrades is naturally her duty.
findings.explanation: The English changes spare capacity into being strongest, downed comrades into weaker members, and duty into a generic natural tendency.

findings.highlight: sleep in a bed, pretending to be her Master
findings.evidenceJa: ベッドで主人のフリをしてる
findings.governingReading: Rider is lying in bed impersonating her Master.
findings.explanation: The English additionally claims Rider is sleeping.

findings.highlight: She’s the one causing us the trouble
findings.evidenceJa: 迷惑かけてるのはあの子の方じゃない、一方的に
findings.governingReading: Rin says Sakura is the one imposing on them entirely one-sidedly.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the blame but omits its unilateral character.

findings.governingReading: The scene registers the audible sound of teeth clicking or grinding.
findings.explanation: The English converts sound into a narrated action and selects gritting as its cause.

findings.evidenceJa: 涼しげに向けられた敵意を受け流す
findings.governingReading: Rider coolly lets Rin’s directed hostility glance off or pass by her.
findings.explanation: The English reduces active composure and deflection to ignoring it.

findings.highlight: She does not match you in ability
findings.evidenceJa: 技量でこそ貴女には及びませんが
findings.governingReading: Sakura falls short of Rin specifically in technical skill, while matching her intuitive talent.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the deficit to overall ability and weakens the deliberate skill-versus-intuition distinction.

findings.highlight: It is good to be graceful
findings.governingReading: Rider says Rin’s clean, decisive acceptance without resistance is admirable.
findings.explanation: The English uses “graceful,” which does not express decisive acceptance.

findings.evidenceJa: これ見よがしに溜息をついて
findings.governingReading: Rin sighs ostentatiously so Rider will notice the performance.
findings.explanation: The English omits the demonstrative manner.

findings.evidenceJa: わずかに顔を俯かせて
findings.governingReading: Rin lowers her face slightly before voicing the worst future.
findings.explanation: The English removes the small degree that keeps the gesture restrained.
